title: Toric rings associated with root systems and conic divisorial ideals via matroid theory
summary: We study conic divisorial ideals from the viewpoint of matroid theory and apply the resulting framework to toric rings arising from root systems. For a toric ring, we describe the polytope representing divisor classes corresponding to conic divisorial ideals in terms of matroids. We then turn to the toric ring $R_P$ associated with a certain subset $P$ of a classical root system, called a signed poset.
